behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert ordered unknown fallback resolution, deduplication, special keys and absent fallback.
Assert handler snapshot, serial payload/result identity, plan-before-dispatch and no failover after error.
docDelivery: Document requested/available/fallback policy and empty requests.
Explain handler snapshot/injection, sequential results and error behavior.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Pure channel selection and deduplication plus snapshot-injected sequential handlers with prevalidated dispatch and no failure retry.
manualBehavior: Notifier delegates full routing plan to shared pure planner before dispatch, without duplicated fallback/dedup logic.
independence: Refactor channel switches into injected handlers preserving fallback, message order and unknown-channel behavior.
